mcp_tools.name: honest_seo_audit_intent_map
mcp_tools.title: Honest SEO audit intent map
mcp_tools.description: Submits an SEO audit and search-intent map record (technical foundation, intent map and on-page craft, structured data and entity clarity, earned authority and measurement, white-hat red lines) and returns a deterministic HONEST_SEO_MAP_SOUND / HONEST_SEO_MAP_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-page intent-ownership and coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it crawls nothing and reads no live data.

inputSchema.description: The honest seo audit intent map manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

site.description: Site or property the audit covers.

pages.description: Declared pages: {name, intent, intent_type, has_single_intent, fully_answers_question}.

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to pass, single page row is valid.
